name: history is the data
headline: History *is* the work
say: Every change you make becomes a new layer, and nothing is ever overwritten. The history of a place is a numbered list, and the newest entry is how it looks now. So undo is not a trick: it is reading an earlier step. You can rewind any page, restore any moment, or take a snapshot of everything before you try something bold. This is source control for everything you make, not only for code. Your history is not a log about your work. It is your work.
